A fictional fixture story used only by the site's tests and screenshots.

## One claim per section

A shop owner may choose to install the robot, and the shop's staff did not. ==Employees and customers will be the ones it sees on its rounds, and nobody asked them first.== The rest of the paragraph is ordinary text again, long enough that a phone wraps it onto several lines.

## A highlight can hold a link and emphasis

A reader who skims can find ==the phrase an editor chose, with a [link to the source](https://example.com/source) and some *emphasis* inside it== without reading every line around it.
